# Existing-code audit boundary

Required inputs: declared scope and version/snapshot; no diff is required. Findings describe existing behavior only, never change attribution. Missing anchors block that conclusion rather than inventing a baseline.
Use the finding template for location/object, evidence, trigger/reproduction, severity, impact, repair scope and category. Zero findings is valid with checked scope; unrun reproduction is an unverified hypothesis. Backend/HTTP evidence is a conditional resource. Security deep scans remain the security asset.
